content_geometry_and_font.basis: A2 is measured Web geometry; A3 is the declared font minimum of all display Text and Button nodes; A4a requires reference-value coverage of at least 80%. At full assignment an absent card fails delivery. A partially observed font set can establish a threshold failure as soon as one known size is below that threshold. In a present card, an observed failed condition decides the conjunction. Joint partial failures only identify observed failing dimensions. Cross-arm and before/after comparisons include the same tasks with two artifacts and observed coverage at both ends. The before/after matrix additionally requires two measured minimum font sizes.

device_evidence.scope: Recorded field names only. Count all accessibility nodes in each unique captured window. A matching name alone cannot establish a resolved font size or its unit.

scope: C-05 counts explicit numeric fontSize on the stored component list. The display-only comparison requires a valid tree and complete positive declarations on Text and Button nodes. A2 uses sealed browser root-box measures. A4a is literal reference-value coverage. Analysis of the same bound value conditions on two artifacts and one unambiguous registered Text binding. These are observational comparisons.
